criteria.evidence: Identity is independently corroborated by OSM way 869182111 (Joyful Journeys, 600 Lindberg Road), the operator page at that address, the 2014 Tippecanoe County Z-2571 staff report, and the 2019 guide exterior photograph whose visible entry number is 600. The 12-point OSM ring visually tracks the roof outline in the saved Esri World Imagery overlay; its source-record area is about 505.66 m². This is a roof/perimeter proxy, not a surveyed wall footprint, and the OSM source does not provide a stated positional accuracy.
uncertainties: Footprint is crowd-mapped OSM and follows apparent roof edge rather than verified wall line.

criteria.evidence: Independent Blender reopen measured world bounds X -104.046..-65.915 m, Y 2056.239..2078.080 m, Z 0.000..8.760 m. XY matches the documented conversion of the OSM ring and the ring overlay visually registers with aerial imagery. The saved mesh is in campus coordinates with zero location/rotation and unit scale. Independent survey/control coordinates are unavailable, so the XY and 38.13 x 21.84 m envelope are only as accurate as the approximate local transform and OSM roof polygon.
uncertainties: No surveyed position or structural wall dimensions; map transform is an approximation.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The 2019 photo supports visible upper-level gable windows and thus a two-level facade interpretation; the aerial supports a low, multi-facet pitched roof. The model records two levels and 8.7 m peak height as estimates. No measured elevation, verified floor count, roof pitch, ridge plan, or eave height was found. The 8.76 m reopened maximum includes the model ridge cap.
uncertainties: Height, floor count, eave level, pitch, and ridge geometry remain photo/aerial interpretations, not measured facts.

criteria.evidence: The saved 2019 exterior photo is address-labeled on its page and visibly supports light trim, siding, dark shutters, upper gable windows, and a covered entry/porch. The r2 render includes these broad cues and a south-side entry canopy. The photo is a cropped view of the entry facade and carries no scale or north orientation; the modeled window count/locations, colors, canopy geometry, and all other elevations are schematic. The render does not reproduce the observed porch railing and fuller column/trim details.
uncertainties: Only a partial, unscaled facade view is available; detailed dimensions and orientation remain unverified.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: I reopened the saved .blend directly in Blender 4.5.15 LTS. It contains the expected scene Building_massing_joyful_journeys_abaf5c3, expected Asset_massing_joyful_journeys_abaf5c3 collection, one Joyful Journeys mesh (886 vertices/218 faces), identity transform, no modifiers, no linked libraries, and no external images. The source record contains raw source snapshots and coordinate/method/uncertainty fields; r2 hero/aerial renders and aerial overlay are present. Deduction: shared manifest still declares Z max 16.0 m while reopened geometry max is 8.76 m, so the coordinator must correct integration bounds.
uncertainties: Shared manifest bounds are stale and inconsistent with the reopened asset; coordinator correction is needed before integration.
